value.rationale: Exact least two-character coherence is a motivated natural quantitative Fourier-sampling invariant for finite approximations to odd-base Cantor measures. The optimizing frequency gap is independent of arbitrary level biases and has exactly two arithmetic classes; the sharp Gram condition number and superexponential-versus-exponential bias transition distinguish spectral behavior unquantified by qualitative frame/nonframe results.
